improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition: AI assistance for trade and business professionals. Open Graph tags ensure consistent, compelling previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook, which is critical for a B2B audience. Including the free trial hook (three free searches) reduces friction and encourages clicks without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional business guidance. Try 3 free searches and see the difference."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it serves (trade and business professionals). The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while clearly stating the free trial offer to reduce friction and encourage engagement. This structure builds trust without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day and unlocks unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace. Choose monthly or annual billing—annual plans save you 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for trial users: understanding what happens at the paywall. It reassures prospects by clearly explaining the transition, reinforcing value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), and highlighting the affordable entry price with a savings incentive. This reduces abandonment and builds trust.
